description: Na₃NiCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.45 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.69 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.67 Å. Ni is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.46 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.29 Å) and two longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-71°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ni, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ni, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ni, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ni, and one P atom.
